style.value: A59 motion-graphics grammar as the SPINE; CINEMATIC TYPOGRAPHY reserved for the number; a 2D CUT DEMONSTRATION at the definition moment. (Base-layer decision — made at the piece's start, per the owner's style law, 2026-10-26.)
style.rationale: DISCUSSION: the superseded build carried NO style decision — the owner's score for its visualization was '10 at most', 'absolutely zero style in this video as an explainer'. From the 14-technique menu (files/a59-motion-brief.md), three picks, each for a named job. (1) SPINE — A59 grammar: one persistent object system with semantic continuity — the token pieces introduced at the definition recur as the count tiles, the stake tiles, and the thinking-stream; objects change role instead of exiting; principal-word entries follow the lane's settled motion (rise 24 px, scale 0.82→1, 0.28 s cubic ease-out; dark void; ground light as contact only). It is also the lane-consistency pick: wd-02's Variant B (adopted, #78) set the Word Definitions family face, and this build wears it. (2) THE NUMBER — cinematic typography (the menu's kinetic typography in its monumental register; reference specimen: soa-01 exp-02): the owner's structure makes the number the entry AND the bookend, so it gets monument scale — a ghosted 520 px numeral behind an amber QUADRILLION — one object in three states (arrival → receded header → return). The monument runs deliberately full-bleed (display layer); narration rows stay inside the safe zone. (3) THE DEFINITION — 2D graphics (flat cut): the one moment that must be SEEN to be learned — a whole word visibly cut into pieces ('unhappiness' → un / happi / ness). ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED: whiteboard — NOT chosen for this build: it is this piece's own exp-02 specimen style, still under the owner's judgment (Action #79); building in it would pre-judge his verdict, and the A59 spine already carries the lane. Pure kinetic typography for the whole piece — rejected: every line a monument spends the number's distinction; the number must be the ONLY monument. Live action / stock — off-lane for Word Definitions. A deliberate mix over a single style because the piece has three distinct jobs — scale, system, demonstration — and the menu exists to be composed, never defaulted.
